# Axiom - Financial Services Static Data System

> A modular monolith financial services platform for managing static data including countries, currencies, entities,
> financial instruments, accounts, and settlement instructions. Built with Go (Gin/Fiber/GORM), Next.js, PostgreSQL,
> and RabbitMQ with integrated Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) data acquisition from GLEIF.

Axiom implements a CQRS architecture pattern with JWT authentication, comprehensive API documentation, and
multi-environment deployment support (dev, UAT, production). Key features include automated LEI data synchronization,
WebSocket support, rate limiting, Prometheus metrics, and containerized deployment via Docker Compose.

## Architecture Decision Records

- [ADR-0001: Modular Monolith](docs/adr/adr-0001-modular-monolith-architecture.md): Architecture pattern choice

- [ADR-0006: Next.js and Tailwind Frontend](docs/adr/adr-0006-nextjs-tailwind-frontend.md): Frontend stack decisions
- [ADR-0007: Docker Compose Local Dev](docs/adr/adr-0007-docker-compose-local-dev.md): Development environment
- [ADR-0008: Sticky Headers with Smooth Transitions](docs/adr/adr-0008-sticky-headers-with-smooth-transitions.md):
  UI sticky header and scroll behaviour pattern
- [ADR-0009: Git Branching Strategy](docs/adr/adr-0009-git-branching-strategy.md): Branch model and environment
  promotion gates
- [ADR-0010: User Auth and Registration](docs/adr/adr-0010-user-auth-registration-system.md): Self-registration,
  admin approval workflow, JWT issuance, and bootstrap admin strategy
- [ADR-0011: User Preferences](docs/adr/adr-0011-user-preferences.md): Per-user UI preferences persisted to the
  database (theme, column visibility, page width) with `useUserPreference` hook and `PreferenceSavePrompt` toast
- [ADR-0012: Internationalisation](docs/adr/adr-0012-internationalisation.md): i18next-based i18n stack, language
  selection on login/register, community translation review workflow, and CI/daily seed integration
- [ADR-0013: Dedicated User Documentation Site](docs/adr/adr-0013-user-documentation-site.md): decision to
  introduce top-level `docs-user/` for polished end-user docs while keeping `docs/` engineering-focused
- [ADR-0014: WCAG Accessibility Standards](docs/adr/adr-0014-wcag-accessibility-standards.md): WCAG 2.2 AA
  baseline for the frontend — contrast, focus visibility, and non-text contrast rules for shared components
- [ADR-0015: Architecture as Code (CALM) Pilot Adoption](docs/adr/adr-0015-architecture-as-code-calm-pilot.md):
  incremental adoption decision for machine-readable architecture with phased CI validation

## Contributing

- [Branching Strategy](docs/contributing/BRANCHING_STRATEGY.md): Branch naming, promotion workflow,
  and protection rules (dev → uat → prod); includes automated promotion behaviour at all levels
- [Branch Setup Script](scripts/setup-branches.sh): gh CLI script to create and protect strategic
  branches
- [CI Workflow](.github/workflows/ci.yml): Unified CI pipeline keyed off branch names for
  environment detection (main, dev, uat, prod)
- [Nightly Promotion Workflow](.github/workflows/promote-main-to-dev.yml): Scheduled workflow that
  opens a promotion PR from main → dev each night to prevent branch drift
- [Weekly Promotion Workflow](.github/workflows/promote-dev-to-uat.yml): Scheduled workflow that
  opens a promotion PR from dev → uat every Monday
- [Monthly Promotion Workflow](.github/workflows/promote-uat-to-prod.yml): Scheduled workflow that
  opens a promotion PR from uat → prod on the 1st of each month

- [Backups Guide](backups/README.md): Timestamped backup workflow, directory structure, and restore guidance
- [Test Stack Isolation Script](scripts/new-main-test-env.ps1): Creates isolated .env files for PR/worktree

- [Postgres Backup Script](scripts/backup-main-postgres.ps1): Creates timestamped pg_dump backups from the
